query:
SELECT
            url AS "url!",
            COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64",
            MAX(id) AS "latest_id!: i64"
        FROM
            media_posts
        WHERE
            chat_id = ?1
            AND (
                ?2 IS NULL
                OR created_at >= ?2
            )
        GROUP BY
            cache_key
        HAVING
            COUNT(*) > 1
        ORDER BY
            COUNT(*) DESC,
            MAX(id) DESC
        LIMIT
            ?3
